scripts.deploy: pnpm build && ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-mr-robot ALCHEMY_PROFILE=mr-robot alchemy deploy --yes
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p infra
scripts.check: pnpm lint:deps && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @mr-robot/web build && pnpm --filter @mr-robot/worker exec wrangler dev -c wrangler.dev.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.cloudflare-login: ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-mr-robot ALCHEMY_PROFILE=mr-robot alchemy profile edit --profile mr-robot --add Cloudflare
